title: Support coverage schedule
description: Published support hours, channels, languages, holiday and year-end coverage, and the out-of-band channel used when the platform is down.

title: Severity matrix and response-time performance report
description: Severity definitions with examples, response and resolution targets, and monthly measured performance per customer from ticket timestamps.

title: Escalation matrix and named contacts
description: Current escalation path with named roles and people, contact methods and backup for each, reviewed quarterly.

title: Support access grant and session log
description: For each support access to tenant data: requester, customer approval reference, scope, purpose, start and expiry, actions taken, and visibility in the customer's access view.

title: AI support agent configuration and evaluation record
description: Disclosure text, permitted tools and data scopes, escalation triggers, model and prompt versions, and periodic evaluation of answer accuracy and escalation behavior.

title: Problem management and known-error register
description: Recurring incidents grouped into problems with root cause, workaround, fix status and customer communication.

title: Support personnel location and subcontractor register
description: Countries from which support is provided, employment versus subcontracted status, and data access each group has.
